ra exule, sedem ex sede mutante, & igno-

gium Cappadoces cessisse?

tentur in Symbolo, quod vocant Apostolico, esse

finem ullum faciant garriendi. Pontificij
& argumentis Hæreticorum abunde respon-

Italic boundaries in the last paragraph are uncertain; the italic setting is partly guessed from the scan. "conseruant" is copied as printed and changed to "conservant" under the u/v rule only in its spelling, so it is written as printed in the text above. Lines are copied as seen; the reading "dienum" after "ho-" is clear, and "propugnát" carries an acute accent as printed.
